newsitem.title: UK: Britain's W.H. Smith doubles profits in first half.
newsitem.headline: Britain's W.H. Smith doubles profits in first half.

text.p: W.H. Smith Group Plc, Britain's biggest bookseller, said Wednesday that its pre-tax profits more than doubled in the first half of its fiscal year.

The retailer, also owner of specialist book stores Waterstones, and the Virgin/Our Price music shops, said its pretax profits soared to 38.6 million pounds ($62.3 million) from 17.3 million ($27.9 million).
Sales from ongoing businesses rose 2 percent to 1.29 billion pounds ($2.08 billion).
